title: EPI Data Dashboard
text:
Empower Playgrounds Inc.



Nonprofit working in rural schools across West Africa
Programs include power-generating merry-go-rounds, science kits, libraries, reusable menstrual kits, remote computer labs
Currently in 70+ partner schools

title: EPI Data Dashboard
text:
The Problem



EPI has been collecting data via Qualtrics surveys since 2018, but very little has been used
No unified view for organization staff
Hard to track organization activities, issues, or measure program reach

title: EPI Data Dashboard
text:
The Solution
An interactive dashboard that consolidates all field data into one place.

title: EPI Data Dashboard
text:
Data Pipeline
Every day at 6 AM, a GitHub Action automatically:

Fetches fresh data from 5 Google Sheets via the googlesheets4 API
Processes it through an R pipeline (import → clean → join → export)
Renders the Quarto site into static HTML
Deploys the updated dashboard
